messages:
Rae (Design): Quick thread: compact dashboard rows feel visually tight at 8px. users like density but were hitting touch and keyboard nits. screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/ui/compact-rows-2.png
Omar (Frontend): Thanks — also seeing the expander lose focus when multiple rows collapse. stacking context issue.
Priya (PM): Can we nudge compact vertical padding to 10px and keep everything else? target: patch release, no token renames.
Nate (Dev): 10px works. chevron expander currently ~36px tap area; a11y-bot: interactive targets must be >=44x44px. we'll add padding to button to meet minimum.
Rae (Design): Plan: icon-only expander visually, add visually-hidden "Expand row"/"Collapse row" copy, aria-expanded, tooltip unchanged. Add compact alias to theme rather than renaming spacing tokens.
a11y-bot: PR checklist: aria-expanded present, hit target >=44x44, focus order correct, screenreader text, contrast >=4.5.
Omar (Frontend): Small CSS patch:
```
.row-expander { padding:6px; min-width:44px; min-height:44px }
.row-content { padding-top:10px; padding-bottom:10px }
```
I'll include unit tests + Percy screenshots.
Nate (Dev): Also noticed toasts anchored top-right overlap sticky header when many expands fire. Suggest increasing toast.offsetTop by 8px in compact theme.
Priya (PM): Non-breaking, ship in 3.2.1. Schedule quick Percy review after CI.
Rae (Design): I'll update token docs with compact alias and post notes to design tokens doc. Thanks all! :sparkles:
